unspoken: There was an unspoken agreement between the two friends that they would never lie to each other.
这两个朋友之间有一种未说出口的约定,就是彼此永不撒谎。
be likely to: Dark clouds are gathering outside, so it seems to be likely to rain at any moment.
外面乌云正在聚集,所以看起来随时都很可能下雨。
in general: In general, students who read a lot tend to write better essays.
总的来说,阅读量大的学生往往作文写得更好。
crossroads: We stopped the car at a crossroads because we were not sure which road to take.
我们在十字路口停下了车,因为不确定该走哪条路。
misread: He misread the map and took the wrong road, so they arrived an hour late.
他看错了地图,走错了路,所以他们迟到了一个小时。
at ease: The friendly teacher made the shy students feel at ease on their first day.
友善的老师让害羞的学生们在第一天就感到轻松自在。
lose face: Nobody wants to lose face in front of the whole class, so he stayed silent.
没有人想在全班同学面前丢脸,所以他保持沉默。
turn one’s back to: In some cultures it is rude to turn one’s back to the person who is speaking.
在某些文化中,背对着正在说话的人是不礼貌的。
Camelot Park: Camelot Park is a theme park in England where visitors can watch shows about life in the Middle Ages.
卡默洛特公园是英国的一座主题公园,游客在那里可以观看关于中世纪生活的表演。
Dollywood: Dollywood is a famous theme park in the USA that celebrates traditional American music and culture.
多莱坞是美国一座著名的主题公园,展示传统的美国音乐和文化。
roller coaster: The roller coaster was so exciting that the children wanted to ride it again and again.
过山车太刺激了,孩子们想一次又一次地乘坐。
fairy tale: When she was a little girl, her grandmother often told her fairy tale stories before bed.
她还是个小女孩的时候,祖母常常在睡前给她讲童话故事。
be modeled after: The designers said the new hall will be modeled after a famous garden in the south.
设计师们说,新大厅将仿照南方一座著名的园林建造。
Merlin the Wizard: In the story, Merlin the Wizard uses his magic to help the young king win the battle.
在故事中,魔术师梅林用他的魔法帮助年轻的国王赢得了战斗。
joust: At the theme park, actors dressed as knights joust on horses to entertain the visitors.
在主题公园里,装扮成骑士的演员们骑马用长矛打斗,为游客助兴。
settler: The first settler built a small wooden house by the river and started a farm.
最早的移民在河边建了一座小木屋,开始经营农场。
athletic: As an athletic young man, he enjoys swimming, running and playing basketball every week.
作为一个擅长运动的年轻人,他每周都喜欢游泳、跑步和打篮球。
translator: She works as a translator, turning English documents into Chinese for an international company.
她是一名译员,为一家跨国公司把英文文件翻译成中文。
Futuroscope: Futuroscope is a science park in France where you can experience the future through exciting technology.
观测未来是法国的一座科学公园,在那里你可以通过令人兴奋的技术体验未来。
T-Rex: The T-Rex in the movie looked so real that some children thought it was still alive.
电影里的霸王龙看起来如此逼真,以至于有些孩子以为它还活着。
in advance: You should book the train tickets in advance, because they sell out quickly during holidays.
你应该提前预订火车票,因为假期里票很快就卖光了。
get close to: Visitors at the safari park can get close to the animals in an open bus.
在野生动物园,游客可以乘坐敞篷巴士近距离接触动物。
come to life: When you put on the special glasses, the pictures seem to come to life.
当你戴上特殊眼镜时,那些图片仿佛活了过来。
Californian: As a Californian, she is used to sunny weather and spending weekends on the beach.
作为加利福尼亚人,她习惯了晴朗的天气和周末在海滩上度过。
live on: People in that small mountain village still live on rice and the fish they catch.
那个小山村的人们仍然以大米和他们捕到的鱼为生。
strait: The ship sailed slowly through the narrow strait between the two islands.
轮船缓慢地驶过两座岛屿之间狭窄的海峡。
Bering: Long ago, some scientists believe, early humans crossed the Bering Strait from Asia to America.
一些科学家认为,很久以前早期人类从亚洲穿过白令海峡来到了美洲。
Arctic: Polar bears live in the Arctic, where the weather is extremely cold all year round.
北极熊生活在北极,那里全年天气都极其寒冷。
the Arctic: In winter, the Arctic is covered with ice and snow, and the sun hardly rises.
冬天,北极被冰雪覆盖,太阳几乎不升起。
by means of…: The disabled man painted beautiful pictures by means of a brush held in his mouth.
那位残疾人用嘴衔着画笔,借助这种方式画出了美丽的图画。
make a life: After moving to the new city, they worked hard to make a life there.
搬到新城市后,他们努力在那里建立起新的生活。
Los Angeles: Los Angeles is famous for its movie industry and its wonderful beaches along the Pacific coast.
洛杉矶以其电影业和太平洋沿岸美丽的海滩而闻名。
keep up: He walked so fast that his little brother could hardly keep up with him.
他走得太快了,他的弟弟几乎跟不上他。
Hollywood: Thousands of young actors move to Hollywood every year, hoping to become famous stars.
每年都有成千上万的年轻演员来到好莱坞,希望成为著名的明星。
Cambodian: The Cambodian student helped us understand the menu because he could speak both languages.
那位柬埔寨学生会说两种语言,他帮我们看懂了菜单。
Korean: My new classmate is Korean, and she is teaching me a few Korean words.
我的新同学是韩国人,她正在教我几个韩语单词。
Pakistani: The Pakistani restaurant near our school serves delicious food with strong spices.
我们学校附近的那家巴基斯坦餐馆供应加了浓香料的美食。
back to back: In the photo, the twin sisters stood back to back and made the same funny face.
在照片里,这对双胞胎姐妹背靠背站着,做出了同样滑稽的表情。
cable car: Instead of climbing the mountain, we took the cable car and enjoyed the view from above.
我们没有爬山,而是乘坐了缆车,从高处欣赏风景。
Andrew Hallidie: Andrew Hallidie invented the cable car in San Francisco after he saw an accident with horses.
安德鲁•海利迪在目睹了一起与马有关的事故后,在旧金山发明了缆车。
